title: Geyser ki gas band karta hai chip nahi, thermocouple! 🔥 #shorts
description:
Lau bujhi to geyser gas kaise band karta hai? Smart sensor nahi, ek thermocouple!
Flame sensor KY-026 aur asli geyser ka safety trick, dono samjho.
🔥 Thermocouple lau ki garmi se 25 mV banata hai
🧲 Wahi voltage magnet valve ko khula rakhta hai
📡 KY-026 760–1100 nm IR dekhta hai
⚠️ KY-026 hobby-grade hai, safety device nahi
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D, roz ek naya Kholke Dekho!
